B

Beta particles are electrons or positrons, both having a charge magnitude of the elementary charge, e. Gamma rays are uncharged photons and are not deflected by electric fields. Alpha particles have a charge of +2e. Alpha particles are the most ionizing, followed by beta, with gamma being the least ionizing.
